生物学.title: Adhesive cationic hyaluronic acid loading with small extracellular vesicles from IL-6 activated mesenchymal stem cells improves repair of corrosive esophageal injury.
生物学.abstract: The treatment of corrosive esophageal injury (CEI) remains challenging due to recurrent courses, frequent complications, and severe tissue damage. Enhancing the therapeutic potential of mesenchymal stem cell-derived small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) through cytokine preconditioning has emerged as a promising strategy. In this study, functionally enhanced sEVs (E-sEVs) were generated by pretreating umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells with interleukin-6 (IL-6). E-sEVs exhibited superior capabilities in promoting fibroblast migration and suppressing macrophage-mediated inflammation compared to naïve sEVs. To improve local retention and therapeutic efficacy, E-sEVs were integrated into a cationic hyaluronic acid (CHA) hydrogel with strong bioadhesive properties, forming a composite system termed E-sEVs@CHA. In vitro assays demonstrated that E-sEVs@CHA effectively promoted endothelial cell invasion, exhibited antioxidant activity, and modulated macrophage polarization toward an anti-inflammatory phenotype. In a rat model of CEI, E-sEVs@CHA significantly reduced esophageal inflammation, oxidative stress, and fibrotic remodeling, leading to improved tissue repair and reduced stricture formation. This study presents a novel cell-free therapeutic strategy with translational potential for the management of corrosive esophageal injury.
生物学.title_ja: IL-6で活性化した間葉系幹細胞由来の小型細胞外小胞を搭載した接着性カチオン性ヒアルロン酸は腐食性食道損傷の修復を改善する
生物学.summary_ja: 腐食性食道損傷（CEI）の治療は難しく、新規戦略が求められる。本研究では、IL-6で前処理した臍帯由来間葉系幹細胞から機能的強化sEV（E-sEVs）を作製した。E-sEVsは線維芽細胞遊走促進とマクロファージ炎症抑制に優れた。これを生体接着性の陽イオン性ヒアルロン酸（CHA）ヒドロゲルに搭載しE-sEVs@CHAを構築した。in vitroで内皮細胞浸潤促進、抗酸化作用、抗炎症性マクロファージ極性化を示した。CEIラットモデルで炎症、酸化ストレス、線維化を軽減し、組織修復改善と狭窄形成抑制を達成した。CEI治療への新規無細胞療法として有望である。

医学.title: Heparin-PEAR-1 interaction contributes to platelet activation by HIT antibodies.
医学.abstract: Heparin is a negatively charged, polysaccharide used as an anticoagulant. In 0.5-1% of patients receiving unfractionated heparin, heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) occurs 5-10 days after exposure. In HIT, heparin binds to platelet factor 4 (PF4), exposing PF4 neoepitopes, allowing binding of heparin-dependent anti-PF4 antibodies, forming immune complexes that activate platelets through FcγRIIA. Recently, we showed that heparin mediates weak/slow aggregation of platelets via platelet endothelial aggregation receptor-1 (PEAR1).
医学.title_ja: ヘパリンとPEAR-1の相互作用は、HIT抗体による血小板活性化に寄与する。
医学.summary_ja: 未分画ヘパリン投与患者の0.5〜1%に、曝露5〜10日後にHITが発症する。HITではヘパリンがPF4に結合してネオエピトープを露出し、ヘパリン依存性抗PF4抗体が結合して免疫複合体を形成、FcγRIIAを介して血小板を活性化する。最近、ヘパリンがPEAR1を介して血小板の弱い/遅い凝集を媒介することが示された。本研究は、ヘパリン-PEAR1相互作用がHIT抗体による血小板活性化に寄与することを示す。

医学.title: Exploratory Single-Cell Analysis of NK-Annotated Cells Across Marrow Compartments in Prostate Cancer Bone Metastasis.
医学.abstract: Prostate cancer preferentially colonizes bone, where marrow compartments differ in tissue structure and immune composition. We reanalyzed a 920,521-cell integrated prostate cancer atlas containing 38,842 NK-annotated cells from 126 sample identifiers, focusing on one bone-marrow cohort of 16 subjects and 32 samples. Distal marrow from patients with bone metastasis was compared with nonmalignant marrow from unrelated hip-replacement controls, while complete within-patient pairs were used for local comparisons. Sample- or subject-level composition, pseudobulk expression, pathway, and microenvironment analyses treated biological units, not cells, as replicates. The inherited CytokNKs_GZMH label was more frequent in distal marrow than in controls (25.4% versus 2.0%; centered log-ratio effect 2.82; false-discovery rate 0.0367). Paired tumor-versus-distal comparisons showed higher relative abundance of ImmSuppNKs_CREM and lower proportions of several other inherited labels at the 10% false-discovery threshold. A pooled comparison identified 62 differential genes within RegNKs_IL7R and generated a 24-gene exploratory program; distal-only models had no genes meeting the joint cutoff. Frequent T-cell- and myeloid-marker detection precluded assignment of this population as a validated NK subset. Program separation within the discovery cohort was subject to gene-selection bias and did not establish predictive performance. Full-atlas analyses described compartment-associated composition differences and candidate ligand-receptor expression pairs. Donor characteristics, treatment, sampling site, specimen processing, and annotation uncertainty remain unresolved sources of confounding. These findings are hypothesis-generating associations in recovered NK-annotated cells, not evidence of a metastasis-specific field effect, a regulatory NK population, or clinical utility.
医学.title_ja: 前立腺癌骨転移における骨髄区画間のNK細胞注釈細胞に対する探索的単一細胞解析
医学.summary_ja: 前立腺癌骨転移の骨髄区画におけるNK注釈細胞を、920,521細胞の統合アトラスから再解析した。骨転移患者の遠位骨髄と非悪性対照を比較し、検体・被験者単位を反復として組成、pseudobulk発現、経路、微小環境を評価した。CytokNKs_GZMHは遠位骨髄で対照より高頻度（25.4%対2.0%、CLR効果2.82、FDR 0.0367）。患者内比較ではImmSuppNKs_CREM増加と他ラベルの低下を認めた。RegNKs_IL7Rで62遺伝子と24遺伝子探索プログラムを同定したが、T細胞・骨髄系マーカー検出によりNK subsetとしての妥当性は未確立。遺伝子選択バイアスや交絡因子も残る。仮説生成的な関連であり、転移特異的field effectや制御性NK集団、臨床的有用性を示すものではない。

医学.title: FTO promotes human NK cell proliferation yet restricts effector functions.
医学.abstract: Human embryonic stem cell (hESC)- or induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived natural killer (NK) cells serve as promising adoptive cell therapies for cancer patients and as valuable models for studying the regulation of human NK cell development and effector functions. In this study, we used shRNA to knock down the expression of FTO in hESCs and differentiated these cells into NK cells to explore the role of FTO in regulating human NK cell development and effector functions. Our data revealed that the FTO knockdown in hESCs resulted in a comparable effect on haematopoietic progenitor cell generation but significantly impaired CD45⁺CD56⁺ NK cell production, which might be attributed to impaired proliferation, as indicated by reduced Ki-67 expression. Functional assays demonstrated that FTO knockdown in hESC-NK cells effectively increased per-cell cytotoxicity, including the expression of perforin, granzyme B, and IFN-γ, and increased degranulation (as indicated by the CD107a level). Integrated MeRIP-seq and RNA-seq analyses identified ADAMTS1 and ZAP70 as key target genes of FTO, demonstrating that FTO knockdown increased m⁶A methylation near the 3'UTR regions of ADAMTS1 and ZAP70 mRNAs and upregulated their transcript levels. ADAMTS1 is a known proliferation inhibitor, whereas increased ZAP70 expression is accompanied by increased phosphorylation of ERK1/2, a downstream component of ZAP70 signalling cascades, which positively regulates the effector functions of NK cells. Overall, our results demonstrate that FTO maintains human NK cell proliferation but restricts their per-cell effector functions, possibly through regulating the m⁶A methylation of ADAMTS1 and ZAP70 mRNAs. Exploring methods to achieve stage-specific FTO knockdown in mature NK cells may provide a potential strategy to optimize hESC-NK cell-based immunotherapy.
医学.title_ja: FTOはヒトNK細胞の増殖を促進するが、エフェクター機能を制限する。
医学.summary_ja: hESC/iPSC由来NK細胞を用い、shRNAでFTOをノックダウンしてその役割を解析した。FTO欠損は造血前駆細胞生成には影響せず、CD45⁺CD56⁺NK細胞産生を有意に低下させ、Ki-67減少を伴う増殖障害が関与した。一方、FTO欠損NK細胞ではperforin、granzyme B、IFN-γ発現やCD107a脱顆粒が増加し、細胞あたりの細胞傷害性が亢進した。MeRIP-seqとRNA-seqの統合解析により、ADAMTS1とZAP70がFTOの標的遺伝子として同定され、FTO欠損は両mRNAの3'UTR近傍のm⁶Aメチル化を増加させ転写レベルを上昇させた。ADAMTS1は増殖抑制因子であり、ZAP70増加はERK1/2リン酸化を伴いNK細胞のエフェクター機能を正に制御する。以上より、FTOはヒトNK細胞の増殖を維持する一方、細胞あたりのエフェクター機能を制限することが示唆された

医学.title: Rewiring the Tumor-Immune Ecosystem: Extracellular Vesicles in the Next Era of Cancer Immunotherapy.
医学.abstract: Cancer immunotherapy has transformed oncology by enabling immune-mediated tumor elimination; however, durable responses remain limited, particularly in solid tumors due to antigen heterogeneity, immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, and adaptive resistance mechanisms. To overcome these barriers, therapeutic paradigms are expanding from single-agent interventions toward programmable cellular and acellular platforms. This review examines recent advances in CAR-T, CAR-NK, and TCR-engineered cell therapies alongside key resistance mechanisms. In parallel, we evaluate the dual biological role of extracellular vesicles (EVs) as mediators of immune evasion and as engineered delivery tools. Rather than presenting multimodal integration as an inherently superior solution, we critically evaluate the trade-offs of combining engineered cells, EVs, checkpoint blockade, oncolytic viruses, and targeted agents, focusing on therapeutic synergy versus cumulative toxicity and biomanufacturing complexity. Collectively, we propose that future cancer immunotherapy will rely on multi-modal, adaptive, and systems-level engineering approaches capable of dynamically reshaping the tumor-immune ecosystem to achieve sustained tumor regression and durable overall survival.
医学.title_ja: 腫瘍免疫エコシステムの再配線：がん免疫療法の次世代における細胞外小胞
医学.summary_ja: がん免疫療法は腫瘍の免疫学的排除を可能にしたが、固形腫瘍では抗原不均一性、免疫抑制性腫瘍微小環境、適応的抵抗機構により持続的奏効が限られる。本レビューはCAR-T、CAR-NK、TCR改変細胞療法の進歩と抵抗機構を検討し、細胞外小胞（EVs）の二面的役割——免疫回避の媒介と工学的デリバリー基盤——を評価する。さらに、改変細胞、EVs、チェックポイント阻害、腫瘍溶解性ウイルス、標的薬の組み合わせについて、治療相乗効果と累積毒性・生物製造の複雑性のトレードオフを批判的に検証する。結論として、今後のがん免疫療法は、腫瘍免疫エコシステムを動的に再構築し、持続的腫瘍退縮と長期生存を達成する多モーダル・適応的・システムズレベルの工学アプローチに依存すると提言する。

生物学.title: Self-Reporting Hierarchical DNA Nanoplatform for Tumor Cell-Selective Senescence Modulation and Immune Remodeling.
生物学.abstract: Therapy-induced senescence (TIS) promotes tumor resistance and recurrence through the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), but achieving tumor cell-selective senescence modulation remains a formidable challenge due to limited cellular specificity, insufficient spatiotemporal control, and the complexity of the secretory program. Here, we develop a self-reporting hierarchical DNA nanoplatform (Gal-lipo@S-CHA) that enables selective senescence reprogramming and immune remodeling in TIS tumor cells. In this design, a newly engineered β-galactosidase-responsive charge-reversal lipid carrier establishes the first layer of senescence selectivity by enabling preferential delivery and enhanced endosomal escape of a hierarchically gated catalytic DNA circuit. Subsequent intracellular decoding of GSH and microRNA-21, two tumor-associated and senescence-enriched molecular signatures, provides a second layer of tumor cell selectivity, activating the circuit specifically in pathological senescent tumor cells. The activated circuit simultaneously generates a fluorescence signal for real-time monitoring and assembles an NF-κB decoy to block NF-κB nuclear translocation, thereby suppressing downstream pro-tumorigenic SASP production at the upstream regulatory source. In vivo studies demonstrate that Gal-lipo@S-CHA effectively remodels the tumor immune microenvironment by enhancing natural killer cell infiltration and M1 macrophage polarization. Collectively, this framework establishes a new paradigm for selectively reprogramming pathological senescence, providing a versatile platform to support immunomodulatory cancer therapies.
生物学.title_ja: 自己報告型階層DNAナノプラットフォームによる腫瘍細胞選択的細胞老化調節と免疫リモデリング

生物学.title: Design and implementation of a paradigm-specific cervical manipulation simulator with objective force-angle feedback.
生物学.abstract: Cervical manipulation is a skill-intensive manual therapy procedure requiring precise control of traction force and angular displacement. Current physiotherapy training relies largely on peer-to-peer practice and subjective feedback, limiting quantitative assessment. This study describes the design and implementation of a paradigm-specific cervical manipulation simulator based on the Cyriax manual therapy concept. The proof-of-concept prototype was constructed from commercially available components with an estimated bill of materials cost of USD 820. An S-type load cell, analogue rotary encoder and USB data-acquisition system recorded traction force and angular position. Three C# software modules provided real-time acquisition, event-based post hoc visualisation and user-selected interval analysis. Angular velocity and acceleration were derived from the angle-time signal, and force-rate variables from the force-time signal; these derived variables were not independently validated against an external reference system. Traction force calibration was performed using verified reference loads, and custom software outputs were compared with the manufacturer's reference software under identical conditions. 生物学.title_ja: 客観的な力と角度のフィードバックを備えた、パラダイム固有の頸椎マニピュレーションシミュレータの設計と実装。
生物学.summary_ja: 本論文は、牽引力と角度変位の精密制御を要する頸部マニピュレーション訓練用に、Cyriax手技療法概念に基づくパラダイム特異的シミュレータを設計・実装したもの。試作機は市販部品で構成し、部品表コストは約820米ドル。S型ロードセル、アナログロータリーエンコーダ、USBデータ収集システムで牽引力と角度位置を記録し、C#製3モジュールがリアルタイム取得、事後可視化、区間解析を担う。角速度・角加速度は角度-時間信号から、力変化率は力-時間信号から導出したが、外部参照系による独立検証は未実施。牽引力校正は検証済み参照荷重で行い、自作ソフト出力を同一条件下でメーカー参照ソフトと比較した。3回の校正サイクルで統合モデルはF(N)=240.740V-36.373。

医学.title: A Novel Plasma Biomarker hsa_circ_0080018 Drives DLBCL Progression via M2 Polarization of Tumor-Associated Macrophages.
医学.abstract: Noncoding RNAs, including circular RNAs (circRNAs), have been demonstrated to play vital roles in tumorigenesis. Uncovering the functions of circRNAs in tumorigenesis and their underlying regulatory mechanisms may suggest new approaches to the development of novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for human cancer. Here we report the important role of hsa_circ-0080018 in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) progression and the potential impact of hsa_circ-0080018 in DLBCL tumorigenesis. Hsa_circ-0080018 was evidently upregulated in newly diagnosed DLBCL patient plasma, and as a reference to classify GCB and non-GCB subtypes. The high expression of hsa_circ-0080018 also appeared in plasma exosome and can transport to tumor microenvironment (TME). In addition, we found that at the molecular level hsa_circ-0080018 acted as a decoy for miR-625-5p and regulated tumor associated macrophage (TAM) polarization by suppressing miR-625-5p that led to IGF-1/IGF-1R pathway activation. The activated IGF-1/IGF-1R pressed macrophage polarizing to M2 and ultimately promoted tumor progression. Our results provided a new potential biomarker in DLBCL plasma that is correlated with cell of origin (COO). The mechanism of circ-0080018 in tumor progression was plasma generated circ-0080018 delivered to TME by exosome and pushed macrophage polarization. Our research may provide a new target for the DLBCL treatment and prognosis in future.
医学.title_ja: 新規血漿バイオマーカーhsa_circ_0080018は腫瘍関連マクロファージのM2極性化を介してDLBCLの進行を促進する
医学.summary_ja: 環状RNAの一種hsa_circ_0080018は、新規診断DLBCL患者の血漿で顕著に高発現し、GCB/non-GCB亜型分類の指標となり得る。また血漿エクソソームを介して腫瘍微小環境（TME）へ輸送される。分子レベルではmiR-625-5pのデコイとして機能し、miR-625-5pを抑制することでIGF-1/IGF-1R経路を活性化させる。これが腫瘍関連マクロファージ（TAM）をM2へ分極させ、腫瘍進展を促進する。本研究はDLBCLの新規血漿バイオマーカーと治療標的の可能性を示す。

医学.title: Engineered exosomes for breast cancer immunotherapy: Emerging strategies and translational potential.
医学.abstract: Breast cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality in women worldwide, despite significant advances in early detection and conventional therapies. Immunotherapy has emerged as a promising strategy to harness the body's immune system to combat tumors. However, limitations such as immune escape mechanisms and inefficient drug delivery continue to challenge its effectiveness. In recent years, engineered exosomes, cell-derived nanoscale vesicles, have gained attention as innovative carriers for cancer immunotherapy due to their natural biocompatibility, low immunogenicity, and inherent targeting capabilities. This review highlights recent advancements in the design and functionalization of exosomes for breast cancer immunotherapy, including the loading of immune-stimulating molecules, genetic cargos, and surface modifications to enhance tumor specificity. We also discuss their advantages over conventional nanocarriers, immunological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and challenges related to clinical translation. While significant progress has been made, further research is needed to overcome current barriers and fully exploit the potential of engineered exosomes as a next-generation platform in breast cancer immunotherapy.
医学.title_ja: 乳がん免疫療法のための工学設計エクソソーム：新たな戦略と臨床応用の可能性
医学.summary_ja: 乳がんは世界的に女性のがん死亡の主因の一つであり、免疫療法は有望だが、免疫逃避機構や薬物送達効率の低さが課題である。近年、細胞由来ナノ小胞であるエクソソームを工学的に改変した「engineered exosomes」が、生体適合性・低免疫原性・標的指向性から免疫療法の新規担体として注目されている。本レビューは、免疫刺激分子・遺伝子カーゴの搭載や表面修飾による腫瘍特異性向上など、乳がん免疫療法に向けた設計・機能化の最新動向を概説する。従来のナノ担体に対する優位性、免疫学的機序、前臨床エビデンス、臨床応用への課題も論じ、次世代プラットフォームとしての可能性と今後の研究の必要性を示す。

医学.title: The Proteome of Plasma Extracellular Vesicles in Latent and Active Tuberculosis Reveals Phase-Specific Composition and Immunometabolic Insights.
医学.abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease that affects millions of people worldwide. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are mediators of intercellular communication that participate in the immunopathogenesis of TB. Here, we characterized plasma EVs from healthy individuals and from individuals with latent (LTB) or active TB (ATB). We found increased total protein concentrations in EVs from LTB and ATB individuals compared to healthy controls, without significant differences in EV concentrations, but reduced exosome abundance in LTB. Proteomic and bioinformatic analysis showed that LTB EVs were enriched in proteins associated with the regulation of inflammation, tissue remodeling, and lipid metabolism, including TGFβ and apolipoproteins (APO) A1 and E. In contrast, ATB EVs were enriched in mycobacterial antigens and host proteins associated with acute inflammation, including serum amyloid A1 and A2 (SAA1/A2) and the calgranulin complex proteins S100A8 and S100A9. These host proteins were central and/or cohesive nodes in the protein-protein interaction networks of these EVs. Dot blot analysis confirmed the increased levels of these EV proteins in a second group of individuals with LTB or ATB. The EV levels of mycobacterial antigens correlated positively with the EV levels of SAA1/A2 and S100A8/A9, but negatively with their levels of TGFβ and APOA1. Principal component analysis and hierarchical clustering suggested that the simultaneous analysis of mycobacterial antigens and these EV proteins could discriminate between healthy, LTB, and ATB individuals. Our findings confirm that plasma EVs provide insights into the host immunometabolic response to TB and may be a source of clinically useful biomarkers.
医学.title_ja: 潜伏性および活動性結核における血漿細胞外小胞のプロテオームは、病期特異的な組成と免疫代謝に関する知見を明らかにする

医学.title: Cancer-Associated Fibroblast Exosomes in Breast Cancer: Mechanisms of Tumor-Stroma Crosstalk and Clinical Implications.
医学.abstract: Breast cancer progression is shaped by a continuous exchange of signals between tumor cells and the surrounding stroma, in which cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are among the most influential partners. This review concentrates on CAF-derived exosomes as the principal vehicles of that exchange, and on how their cargo and mode of delivery differ across functionally distinct CAF subtypes. 医学.title: Analysis of the role of BAP31-related exosomal miRNAs as potential prognostic biomarkers for gastric cancer.
医学.abstract: Owing to the nonspecific nature of early symptoms of gastric cancer, the high postoperative recurrence rate, and considerable interindividual heterogeneity, accurate prognosis assessment is essential for optimizing individualized clinical management. BAP31 is closely associated with gastric cancer, and the progression of this malignancy is exacerbated by elevated levels of BAP31 expression. This study aims to investigate the relationship between miRNAs derived from BAP31-overexpressing exosomes (BAP31-exos) and prognostic models in gastric cancer. High-throughput sequencing was used to detect the expression levels of miRNAs in BAP31-exos to screen for differentiated miRNAs. The effects of differentiated miRNAs on cell proliferation were evaluated by CCK-8 and colony formation assays. The target genes of the miRNAs were predicted and protein‒protein interaction (PPI) network was analyzed using the STRING database and visualized through Cytoscape. LASSO regression analysis was conducted on the predicted target genes to construct a prognostic risk scoring model, which was verified through Cox regression analyses, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, and Kaplan‒Meier analysis, and the prognostic model was visualized using a nomogram. Three significant miRNAs were screened from the BAP31-exos. Exosomes promoted the proliferation of GCs via these three miRNAs. The predicted target genes were significantly enriched in tumor-related signaling pathways, leading to the identification of hub genes. A gastric cancer risk scoring model was established. This study reveals the important role of BAP31-related miRNAs in the prognosis of GC. A reliable risk prognosis scoring model for gastric cancer was established, facilitating the development of individualized diagnosis strategies.
医学.title_ja: 胃がんの予後予測バイオマーカーとしての可能性を持つBAP31関連エクソソームmiRNAの役割に関する解析
医学.summary_ja: BAP31高発現エクソソーム（BAP31-exos）由来miRNAと胃癌予後の関係を検討した研究。ハイスループットシーケンスでBAP31-exos中のmiRNAを解析し、3つの有意なmiRNAを同定。これらは胃癌細胞の増殖を促進した。標的遺伝子は腫瘍関連シグナル経路に濃縮され、hub遺伝子を特定。STRINGデータベースとCytoscapeでPPIネットワークを解析し、LASSO回帰で予後リスクスコアモデルを構築。Cox回帰、ROC曲線、Kaplan-Meier解析で検証し、ノモグラムで可視化した。BAP31関連miRNAは胃癌予後に重要であり、信頼性の高いリスク予後スコアモデルは個別化診断戦略の開発に寄与する。

医学.title: Mapping the knowledge landscape and identifying frontiers of mitochondrial dysfunction in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury: a four-decade bibliometric and visualized analysis.
医学.abstract: Mitochondrial dysfunction has been recognized as a central pathogenic event and is under active investigation as a candidate therapeutic target in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury (SA-AKI). This study aims to employ multi-tool bibliometric analysis to systematically map the four-decade intellectual landscape of this field, thereby identifying emerging research hotspots and outlining priority-setting directions for future pharmacological investigation. Because publication and citation metrics quantify scholarly attention rather than therapeutic efficacy, the pathways highlighted here reflect research trends and priority-setting signals, not established therapeutic targets. A comprehensive literature retrieval was conducted across PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus up to March 18, 2026. Following rigorous data cleaning, 837 publications were analyzed using CiteSpace, VOSviewer, and the bibliometrix R package to visually evaluate publication trends, knowledge networks, and evolving research hotspots. summary:
以下、注目すべき5トピックです。

1. **FTOとNK細胞**：FTO欠損はヒトNK細胞の増殖を障害する一方、エフェクター機能は逆に亢進。代謝制御と細胞療法設計の新指標となる。

2. **HITとPF4/ヘパリン**：ヘパリン-PEAR-1相互作用がHIT抗体による血小板活性化に関与。血栓症機序の理解と新規抗血栓戦略に重要。

3. **CAFエクソソームと乳癌**：癌関連線維芽細胞由来エクソソームが腫瘍-間質クロストークを媒介。サブタイプ別カーゴ解析が治療標的探索を加速する。

4. **IL-6刺激MSC由来sEV**：腐食性食道損傷修復を促進。線維芽細胞遊走と炎症抑制を両立し、難治性損傷の再生医療に道を開く。

5. **血漿EVプロテオームと結核**：潜伏性・活動性結核でEV組成が段階特異的に変化。新規バイオマーカーと免疫代謝理解に貢献する。

以上、NK細胞代謝制御、HIT機序、EV創薬、再生医療、感染症診断の5領域が特に注目されます。
